name: Strawberry Ice Cream II
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Wash and hull berries, sprinkle with sugar, let stand one hour, mash, and rub through strainer.
Scald one and one-half cups milk; dilute arrowroot with remaining milk, add to hot milk, and cook ten minutes in double boiler; cool, add cream, freeze to a mush, add fruit, and finish freezing.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
